reason: I would forward a few receipts to the free version, since that costs nothing, but I would not pay yet. Half of what my staff send are faded warung notes and handwritten nota in Indonesian, and if I end up correcting rows at midnight I might as well scroll the Telegram group like I do now.
objection: It will misread faded or handwritten Indonesian receipts, and then I am fixing the sheet as well as checking the chat, so I do twice the work for $19 a month.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it read my worst real receipts during the free 30, the handwritten and faded ones from the group, with the right totals and catching a duplicate I had missed.
